components_chart_pn: A minified helper function bundled in Chart.js's chart.js widget file, likely part of the Luxon date-adapter internals.
components_chart_rescale: Luxon Duration.rescale(), which re-expresses a duration's stored values in a new set of units (works with normalize, shiftToAll and toObject).
components_chart_reset: Chart.prototype.reset(), which resets all Chart.js datasets and their elements back to their initial (pre-animation) state.
components_chart_resyncelements: Chart.js DatasetController._resyncElements(), which reconciles the number of rendered chart elements with the current dataset's data length.
components_chart_rotate: A Chart.js canvas helper that rotates the drawing context around a point, used when rendering rotated axis tick labels.
components_chart_sc: A minified Luxon Locale helper used for locale resolution (works alongside isEnglish and Intl's resolvedOptions).
components_chart_sd: A minified Chart.js plugin-service helper used when creating or retrieving plugin option descriptors.
components_chart_setdimensions: Chart.js Scale.prototype.setDimensions(), which computes a scale's box width and height from the chart layout.
components_chart_so: A minified helper function in Chart.js's bundled chart.js core.
components_chart_textalign: A Chart.js Tooltip helper that determines text alignment when drawing the tooltip title, body and footer.
components_chart_tickformatfunction: Chart.js Scale._tickFormatFunction(), which formats a numeric or date tick value into its displayed label text.
components_chart_ticksize: Chart.js Scale._tickSize(), which computes the pixel length of axis tick marks.
components_chart_toformat: Luxon DateTime.prototype.toFormat(), which renders a DateTime as a string using a custom format token string.
components_chart_tojsdate: Luxon DateTime.prototype.toJSDate(), which converts a Luxon DateTime instance into a native JavaScript Date object.
components_chart_tolocalestring: Luxon DateTime.prototype.toLocaleString(), which formats a DateTime using Intl locale-aware formatting options.
components_chart_tooltipposition: Chart.js Element.prototype.tooltipPosition(), which returns the coordinates used to anchor a tooltip to a chart element.
components_chart_tostring: Luxon DateTime.prototype.toString(), which returns the ISO 8601 string representation of a DateTime.
components_chart_uo: A minified Chart.js color-handling helper, used alongside rgb() color parsing utilities.
components_chart_updatedataset: Chart.prototype._updateDataset(), which updates a single dataset's controller and notifies plugins during a chart update.
components_chart_updatehoverstyles: Chart.prototype._updateHoverStyles(), which applies and removes hover styling on chart elements as the active set changes.
components_chart_updatescales: Chart.prototype._updateScales(), which builds or updates all of a chart's axis scales.
components_chart_values: A Chart.js legend-rendering helper that draws label values and their color swatches.
components_chart_vh: A minified Chart.js helper resembling a Set/Map-style collection utility (add/has semantics).
components_chart_vn: A minified Chart.js canvas-drawing helper used near rotation and arc-drawing routines.
components_chart_vo: A minified helper function in Chart.js's bundled chart.js core, similar in role to So().
components_chart_wd: A minified helper function in Chart.js's bundled chart.js core.
components_chart_weekdays: Luxon Info.weekdays(), which returns an array of localized weekday names.
components_chart_xi: A minified Chart.js/Luxon helper related to value normalization.
components_chart_xl: A minified Luxon Locale helper dealing with week-numbering settings such as minimum days in the first week and start-of-week.
components_chart_xu: A minified helper function in Chart.js's bundled chart.js core.
components_chart_ya: A minified Chart.js helper invoked as part of the internal chart update pipeline.
components_chart_yn: A minified Chart.js spline helper used alongside updateControlPoints() when drawing curved (bezier) line segments.
components_chart_zn: A minified helper class or constructor function in Chart.js's bundled chart.js core.
components_chart_zo: A minified Chart.js dataset-controller helper used with getLabels() and parse() when reading dataset data.
components_code_editor_addactions: A CodeMirror editor helper that registers available code actions/quick fixes into the editor's action state.
components_code_editor_addchild: A Lezer Markdown block-parser helper (BlockContext.addChild) that appends a parsed child node to the current block context.
components_code_editor_addinfopane: A CodeMirror tooltip helper that adds an informational panel (e.g. for autocomplete details) to the editor UI.
components_code_editor_addinlinewidget: A Lezer Markdown inline-parser helper that appends an inline widget/mark token to the current parse buffer.
components_code_editor_addnamespace: A language-completion helper in Filament's code editor that adds a namespace entry to the autocomplete suggestion list.
components_code_editor_ao: A CodeMirror editor helper related to cursor positioning and line-boundary navigation.
